mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 3% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to reduced risk-free discounting of future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 3.0% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, p > 0.05 (t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE above 3.5% predicts a negative S&P 500 60-day forward return as higher labor market disengagement reduces corporate investment expectations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 3.5% in the current month
regime_hint: Elevated unemployment or weak wage growth
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive when UNRATE > 3.5%, p < 0.05 (two-tailed).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly GDPC1 (real GDP) exceeds INDPRO by more than 10% for two consecutive quarters, it signals robust consumer demand that precedes a positive S&P 20-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 - INDPRO > 0.10 for two consecutive months
regime_hint: Economic expansion with strong demand relative to production
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day forward return when the GDPC1-INDPRO gap exceeds +10% for two months (Granger causality rejected).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in INDPRO of at least 5% followed by a rise in HOUST above 1400 indicates supply-side weakness that precedes a negative S&P 5-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines 5% over two months, then HOUST rises above 1400 in the third month
regime_hint: Supply contraction in manufacturing and energy
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is positive when the described supply pattern occurs (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% for three consecutive months, the S&P 20-day forward return is positive, reflecting lower discounting and higher equity present value.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than average when FEDFUNDS > 2% for any 3-month window (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in PAYEMS (labor market activity) above 155,000 in a month coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as strong hiring signals economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 155,000 in the current month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive when PAYEMS > 155,000 (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) exceeds 700,000 for two consecutive months, it predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return via optimism about consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS crosses above 700,000 in the current month and remains above for the next month
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day return when RSAFS > 700,000 for two months (Granger causality rejected).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 3% combined with a decline in INDPRO by 8% in the prior month predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return due to supply-side constraints and reduced investment.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.0% and INDPRO < previous value by 8% in the prior month
regime_hint: Labor market slack and production contraction
failure_condition: 60-day forward return is positive when both UNRATE < 3% and INDPRO falls by >8% (p < 0.05).
